name: Rudy
description: Rudy est un homme âgé au visage ridé, portant une casquette plate en velours côtelé marron, des lunettes rondes orange, une longue barbe blanche et une chemise beige avec un tablier marron.

tonePrompts.neutral: A medium close-up portrait of an older man, presented as an isolated subject on a transparent background with no scenery or backdrop. He has an oval-shaped face with visible wrinkles, suggesting age and experience, and a slightly tanned complexion. His eyes are dark, calm, and gaze directly forward, conveying a sense of quiet contemplation. His thin, grey eyebrows are slightly furrowed, adding to his thoughtful expression. A long, thick, and well-groomed white beard dominates his lower face, extending down towards his chest, with grey hair visible at his temples and sideburns. He wears a textured, light brown corduroy flat cap, positioned slightly askew on his head. Distinctive round, thick-rimmed glasses in an orange-brown hue frame his eyes. His attire consists of a light beige collared shirt, buttoned up, layered with a dark brown apron that has two visible straps over his shoulders. The overall expression is neutral and serene. The frontal pose captures his head and upper torso, illuminated by soft, even, and slightly warm lighting that highlights his features without creating harsh shadows.
